problem:
Consider the system $Ax=b$, where the matrix $A$ and the vector $b$ are given below. Given that the columns of $A$ are linearly independent, find the minimum value of $‖Ax-b‖.$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 2 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-10 \\ 5 \\ 0 \\ -5\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: The Least-Squares Solution of a Linear System (Without Collinearity)
